manifestations.description: Hyperaesthesia/paraesthesia: band round chest below the nipple line giving sensations akin to electric shocks; feelings of unusual heat and cold in the feet and legs
Partial loss of sensation from the nipple line downwards to the feet
Bilateral spasticity with spontaneous jerking movements of the legs and positive clonus
Urinary problems: need to urinate more frequently, short warning time, waking 3-5 times at night, occasional wetting
Diminished bowel control: sudden urge to defecate with very little warning, episodes of soiling during physical activity
Diminished sexual interest and activity; decreased sexual potency and loss of sensation
Reduced rotational ability and reduced twisting strength of the left forearm and wrist; numbness down the outside of the left index finger
Severe pain across back and hyperaesthesia following prolonged activity; poor sleeping due to discomfort

treatments_received: open reduction and internal fixation of the left radius
open reduction and internal fixation of the left ulnar styloid
closed reduction of left second metacarpal fractures and percutaneous pinning fixations
multiple laceration wounds debridement, lavage and repair of left arm, hand and shins
intense rehabilitation and physiotherapy (described in Ms. Nalini Advani's report of 23rd February 1993)
re-plating of the forearm fracture (operation on 6 October 1993)
removal of plate in left forearm (operation on 15 June 1995)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Substantial reduction in ability to compete in triathlon and tennis (cycling about 20% less, running about 30% less), inability to pursue prior athletic level or win anticipated competitions
Removal as Director of Tennis and later termination as Head Professional with loss of retainer and reduced commission leading to significant loss of earnings

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Diminished sexual interest and activity; decreased sexual potency; severely reduced marital relations
Partial loss of urinary and bowel control causing need to plan activities (e.g., empty bowels before exercise), frequent nocturnal urination and episodes of incontinence
Strain on marital relationship caused by diminished sexual relations and the physical effects (e.g., sleeping separately due to thrashing, embarrassment from incontinence)

comparable_cases.injury_description: Court of Appeal range for 'substantial injury' category cited as $540,000 - $660,000
